Container.Name: estate-organiser
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted Estate Organiser for two siblings administering an English estate. Keep the container behind Cloudflare Tunnel and Cloudflare Access. Create /mnt/user/appdata/estate-organiser/estate.env before starting.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent database, uploaded documents, and estate.env. The v1 container runs as root, so files created here will be owned by root.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Estate Organiser HTTP port. Publish this only on the Unraid LAN; Cloudflare Tunnel should be the public entrance.
